title: Tie rod with uniform lateral load: deflection, end slope and moment, with and without the tensile force

source.work: ANSYS, Inc., Mechanical APDL Verification Manual (public help site ansyshelp.ansys.com)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text; the sketch was not readable). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part II, 3rd ed. 1956, p. 42, article 6 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'Target' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Rod of 200 in, square section 2.5 in x 2.5 in (A = 6.25 in^2, I = 3.2552 in^4), E = 30e6 psi, uniform lateral load 1.79253 lb/in, tensile force 21,972.6 lb. Supports: both ends held laterally and free to rotate, one end free to move axially - the page's text asks for the slope at the end and uses symmetry about midspan (the sketch was not readable). Combination 'stiffened': second-order analysis with the tensile force (exact stability functions for tension); 'unstiffened': first-order analysis of the lateral load alone. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
